rec.name: PDP Benefits Slider (Infinite Icon Marquee)
rec.status: Reference only (live example on desktronic.de; spec written as acceptance criteria)

what.text: A custom Shopify section, "PDP Benefits Slider", that shows 6 or more product benefits as icons or images with short titles in a continuously looping carousel. The carousel moves automatically and can also be moved manually. It has a headline and a subheadline above it. In the screenshot there is also a large faded number ("6") behind the headline.

why.text: Showing the product's key features as quick-scan icons makes the main selling points visible at a glance, so buyers take them in without reading long copy. The constant motion draws the eye to the section and shows that there are more benefits than fit on screen. The headline with a number ("6 adjustable points") and the subheadline ("You are an original. SitOne adapts to you.") frame the product as customizable and personal. This reduces doubt about fit and comfort for a considered, higher-priced purchase such as an office chair.

how.text: Build a theme section with a header (headline and subheadline, both rich text) and repeatable blocks, one per benefit (icon/image + title). Render the blocks in a horizontal track and duplicate the set so the loop is seamless. Animate with CSS (a translate keyframe) or a lightweight JS slider (e.g. Swiper or Splide) using linear easing and constant speed, so there is no stutter or visible jump at the loop point. Offer manual control (swipe/drag) alongside the autoplay. Use responsive items-per-view: at least 5 on desktop, about 3 on tablet and 1–2 on mobile. Keep the motion running at every viewport. Make the speed a select setting (slow/medium/fast) that maps to the animation duration. Blocks are sortable in the Customizer.

items: Benefit block order (drag-and-drop sorting in the Customizer)
Autoplay and/or manual navigation, endless loop

dependencies.text: No apps required. It needs a theme that supports sections with repeatable blocks and image pickers (Online Store 2.0). It needs a lightweight slider library or CSS animation. The icon assets (SVG/PNG) must be supplied per product. A product-specific template is needed for per-product content. Optional: a faded background number behind the headline appears in the screenshot but is not in the acceptance criteria.

items: Scroll depth to and past the section

images.caption: Final UI: faded number "6" behind the headline "6 Verstellbare Punkte" (6 adjustable points), subheadline, and a row of line-art icons with short captions. The last item is partly faded at the edge, showing the continuous scroll.
Layout of the items: icon above a centered short title, evenly spaced on a light neutral background, with about 6–7 items visible across the desktop width.
